fresh_source.source_truth: Exact qualified AQ parent source birth and original graph evaluator, with only source-scoped seed/operator rebinding. Do not construct or evaluate either DEV cohort in F124-AR.

Yggdrasil.goal: Isolate public-example operator learning, calibration/normalization and 7+9-cognition downstream scoring without optimizing against historical DEV.
controls: AQ sparse XOR candidate with frozen public calibration
AQ fixed sparse XOR forced decode even if public validation fails — diagnostic only
AG original 7+9 transition with evaluator-true source inverse — source-only ceiling
AG transition with unparsed raw graph — diagnostic only
measures: per-graph public validation wrong-bit distribution and abstention
forced decoded 16-bit mapping Hamming error on all edges against source-truth inverse
correctly recovered inverse count over both paired graphs
per-case FP/FN and paired sensitivity under normal/forced/oracle/raw
attribution between threshold, mapping and original scorer failures
Yggdrasil.model_boundary: Prediction always precedes evaluator access to source operator and true inverse. Source-only diagnostics must never be fed into the learned model or used to pick a coefficient.
Yggdrasil.capacity: 7 active +9 retained cognitive cells; additional per-task feature bits/fit operations recorded separately.
Yggdrasil.eligibility: This is an investigation only, not a learned candidate selection. No development promotion and no DEV use.

Wingless.goal: Determine whether AQ relative-lookahead false-positive reductions on prior TRAIN survive a new frozen TRAIN cohort and which graph/operator strata changed, without reusing AQ's consumed DEV for fitting.
measure: same normalized source truth and graph for candidate and baseline
FP/FN, paired correct, margin signs and median signed margins
negative-case FP changes and long-positive preservation per case
by structural family, operator family and causal depth
explicit one packed 12-bit state/node <=64 nodes, measured extra hop ops
Wingless.eligibility: Only a robust diagnostic signal if FP strictly decreases overall, FP never increases in any of four families, every baseline-accepted 13–15-hop positive individually retained, and paired accuracy not below original. Even if met, no first-use DEV in F124-AR; prospectively preregister a distinct subsequent test.
Wingless.capacity: original one 12-bit retained state per node; no extra retained cache, path or beam.

qualification.one_integration_regression: One final full go test -count=1 ./..., race, vet, build and isolation, after frozen diagnostic TRAIN run. Focused Windows/Linux and original proof custody first.
